headlines.title: Why Is Cisco Stock Falling Today Despite Higher Quarterly Revenue and Earnings?
headlines.summary: Cisco Systems (NASDAQ:CSCO) shares declined nearly 2% in US premarket trading on Friday, November 13, as investors assessed narrowing profit margins and valuation considerations following the networking equipment company’s fiscal first-quarter results. Cisco reported revenue and adjusted earnings above analysts’ expectations for the quarter ended in fiscal 2027, while also raising its full-year financial guidance and increasing its artificial intelligence infrastructure revenue target.

headlines.title: Futures Edge Lower As NVDA Fallout Unsettles Tech Stocks — SLS, AMAT, CSCO, CADL Stocks In Focus
headlines.summary: Investors head into Friday amid uncertainty around tech stocks, mixed earnings reactions and concerns over Middle East tensions, with October’s PPI inflation data also in focus.

headlines.title: How Cisco Is Rewiring Its Corporate Structure for the AI Era
headlines.summary: Cisco Systems President and Chief Product Officer Jeetu Patel discusses the practical realities of integrating artificial intelligence at an enterprise scale. He explains the cultural shift needed to ease employee anxiety, the roll-out of "token budgets" for managers and why the tech giant is dismantling internal walls to operate as a unified platform company.  Recorded on October 28, 2026.

headlines.title: US Stock Futures Edge Lower as Nvidia Leadership Changes Offset Cisco and Applied Materials Forecasts: Dow Jones, S&P, Nasdaq, Wall Street
headlines.summary: US stock index futures traded slightly lower on Friday as investors assessed developments surrounding Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA), alongside financial updates from Cisco Systems (NASDAQ:CSCO) and Applied Materials (NASDAQ:AMAT), disruptions affecting Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) services and movements in commodity markets. At 03:01 ET (08:01 GMT), Nasdaq 100 futures were down 74 points, or 0.

headlines.title: Huang ouster fallout; Cisco, Applied Materials outlooks - what’s moving markets
headlines.summary: Investing.com - Futures connected to the major U.S. stock indices drift, as investors look ahead to the release of new inflation data and tremors from outgoing Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation rattle through global markets. Even as traders fret over the future of Nvidia, Cisco Systems and Applied Materials provide upbeat outlooks that underscore the strength of artificial intelligence demand.

description: Cisco Systems, Inc. designs, develops, and sells technologies to power, help, secure, and draw insights from the internet in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, Japan, and China. The company provides data center switching; network security, identity and access management, and secure access service edge; identity and agentic security solutions; interconnects public and private wireline and mobile networks, delivering connectivity to campus, data center, and branch networks; WEBEX suite, collaboration devices, and contact center; communication platform as a service software, including perpetual licenses, subscription arrangements, and hardware solutions; network assurance and observability suite; accelerated issue resolution, software support, and hardware replacement; professional services, such as planning, design, implementation, and high-value consulting; service and support packages, financing, and managed network services; and regional, national, and international wireline carriers, webscale products, internet, and cable. It also provides wireless products, including indoor and outdoor coverage designed for seamless roaming use of voice, video, and data applications; end-to-end collaboration solutions through cloud, on-premise, or within hybrid cloud environments. In addition, it offers technical support services. The company serves businesses, public institutions, governments, and service providers. It sells its products and services directly, through systems integrators, service providers, and resellers, and distributors. It has a collaboration with NVIDIA Corporation to develop Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP), a high-density optical module pluggable transceiver. Cisco Systems, Inc. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
